bias.en: Uptrend pausing · lost the 10-day, SAR and MACD turned
bias.zh: 上升趋势暂歇 · 失守 10 日均线，SAR 与 MACD 转弱

read.en: Berkshire Hathaway B fell 2.1% on Nov 18 to $574.62, trading $573.09–583.72. It dropped below the 5-day ($587.4) and 10-day ($582.7), both still rising, but stays above the rising 30-day ($552.8), 100-day ($518.9) and 200-day ($501.9). MACD crossed just below its signal on Nov 18, above zero; Parabolic SAR flipped bearish the same day ($596.92), and RSI eased to 60.7 from 79.5 five sessions ago.
read.zh: 伯克希尔 B 11月18日下跌 2.1%，收于 $574.62，盘中区间 $573.09–583.72。股价跌破 5 日（$587.4）和 10 日均线（$582.7），两者仍在上行，但仍位于上行的 30 日（$552.8）、100 日（$518.9）和 200 日均线（$501.9）上方。MACD 于 11月18日小幅下穿信号线，在零轴上方；抛物线 SAR 同日翻转看空（$596.92），RSI 从五个交易日前的 79.5 回落至 60.7。

read.en: The drop broke the $583.2 (10-day, Nov 10 close) and $577–579 (Nov 4 close) supports, now resistance; the close sits just above the Nov 5 and 6 closes ($570.9–572.3). Resistance is $577–579, then $582.7–583.7 (10-day, Nov 18 high) and $587.4–590.1. Support is $570.9–573.1, then $562.5 (Nov 4 and 9 lows) and $552.8 (30-day). A close above $583.7 would target $587–590; below $570.9, $562.5.

s.en: Nov 6 close $570.89; Nov 5 close $572.33; Nov 18 low $573.09
